description: Appendix 3: Simulated Dataset for "Simulation Analysis of Electric Car Integration into On-Site Photovoltaic System is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Vojtěch Zavřel, Hynek Mečíř (Czech Technical University in Prague). This dataset contains simulated annual energy-balance results for 430 scenarios analysed in the diploma thesis Simulation Analysis of Electric Car Integration into On-Site Photovoltaic System. The simulations evaluate the integration of an electric vehicle into a family house electricity system with an on-site photovoltaic installation, including scenarios with and without Vehicle-to-Home operation. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
